property_summary: For any callee and non-empty calldata, C.forward must invoke the callee with exactly that calldata (so a callee that accepts arbitrary data succeeds), but the mutant sends empty bytes, causing such a callee to reject the call and forward to revert.
change_summary: Replace the forwarded calldata with empty bytes so the callee receives no data, changing the callee's invocation (e.g. calls a fallback instead of the intended function).
